title: Blowhorn Tells promotion
description: data/tells.json: where the free Am I a Bot? tool (Blowhorn Tells) lives and the copy for every place the site promotes it. Every link is built by layouts/_partials/tells-link.html from url, pages and utm, with utm_content set to one of placements; the partial fails the build on an unknown page or placement, and .github/scripts/check_tells.py fails it when a placement goes missing from its page. Plain text, hyphens never em dashes. Marketing copy says browser, never Chrome; only the docs card says Chrome profile.

url.description: The Tells home page, with its trailing slash.

pages.description: Paths on Tells, relative to url, that the site links to.

utm.description: The fixed UTM parameters every Tells link carries; utm_content is the placement.

placements.description: Every utm_content value the site may send. check_tells.py maps each to the page it must appear on.

nav.description: The top-level header item, after Pricing and before Download.

callouts.description: Copy for layouts/_partials/tells-callout.html: compare on every /compare/<slug>/ page, agents on /ai/ only.

thanks.description: The card on /download/thanks/ after the install steps.

docs.description: The card in every docs page's table of contents column (end of the page below 1280px).
